claim: Canonical enum of artifact URI schemes. Each scheme declared inline with its URI form. The enum is closed: no artifact value with a scheme outside this set is permitted on active beliefs.

definitions.code: An anchored site within a repository file. Form: code:<repo-relative-path>#<anchor>. Everything after the first '#' is one opaque literal substring anchor (the fixed-string grep target); an optional trailing '@<N>' selects the Nth match, and a literal trailing '@<digits>' is percent-encoded as '%40<digits>'. Line numbers are never stored - they resolve at render/run time. document: remains the whole-file reference.
definitions.commit: A git commit in a repository, cited as the change-event that implements or discharges a belief. Form: commit:<sha> where <sha> is the full 40-hex-char commit id (content-addressed, so the reference never drifts - the temporal analog of code:'s spatial anchor). Resolved via git (mix cb.verify.commits) in the host repository.
definitions.document: A repository file reference. Form: document:<repo-relative-path>. Files under ops/, dates/, lib/, etc.
definitions.https: An external URL. Form: https:<URL-rest>. Web pages, papers, external resources.
definitions.session: A working session reference. Form: session:<date-or-descriptor>. Resolved via session transcript (persistence pipeline pending).
definitions.source: A cached source document reference. Form: source:<slug>. Documents stored under ops/sources/ or similar.
definitions.user: A direct user statement. Form: user:<name>:<date>. Internal authorship provenance.

invariants: Exactly one rule entry, with field 'artifact-scheme'.
Values are unique within the entry.
Every value has a corresponding entry in the definitions map.
For all active beliefs b where b.artifact is not null: scheme(b.artifact) is in values.

evidence.detail: Adds the commit: scheme, resolving cb:b545 as option 1 (operator decision 2026-07-01): the belief<->commit link becomes structural rather than prose convention. A prescription's discharge can cite the implementing commit as a typed artifact, CB.CommitLocator parses it, and mix cb.verify.commits dereferences every cited sha and checks Belief: commit trailers name live beliefs - CI-enforced both ways. The seven inherited schemes and all five invariants carry forward verbatim from cb:b066.

Accepted via human adjudication against cb:b066. Reasoning: Single-scheme extension of the closed artifact-scheme enum, resolving cb:b545 as option 1 by operator decision (2026-07-01): add commit:<sha> so the belief<->commit link is structural and CI-enforceable, not a prose convention. The commit scheme names a git primitive, not a connector or product, so the b066 architectural invariant (core names no connector) is respected. All seven inherited schemes, definitions, and the five invariants carry forward verbatim; single-scheme supersession consistent with b397's batching discipline, the same shape as the b043->b066 move. Sibling contract-level matches in preflight (b039, b041, b050, b059) are topical overlap on dag-schema tags/subjects, not contradictions - this proposal touches only the artifact-scheme enum.
